intent: A safari guide at dusk: unhurried, exact, proud of the herd.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which country has the MOST elephants?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Which country has the most elephants?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: Botswana. About 130,000 savanna elephants, more than any other country on Earth.

lines.direction: bar race, the winner keeps going
lines.text: Zimbabwe has about 83,000. Tanzania about 43,000. Botswana runs away with 130,000.
In a country of two and a half million people. One elephant for every nineteen of them.

lines.direction: fly north, land on the delta
lines.text: Most of them roam the north, around the Okavango Delta, a wetland in the middle of the desert.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: A third of the herd. Follow us.
